question: How much wage compensation per trainee is provided under PM DAKSH Yojana including Common Cost Norms for trainees having 80% and above attendance in Reskilling/Upskilling?
solution:
The correct answer is __**₹3,000**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• PM DAKSH Yojana is an initiative launched by the Government of India to provide training and employment opportunities to the youth of the country.
 
• Rs. 3000 is the wage compensation per trainee is provided under the PM DAKSH Yojana
 
• The scheme aims to provide training and apprenticeship opportunities to over 1 crore youth by 2025.
 
• The scheme provides wage compensation to the trainees during the training period to support them financially.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Rs. 6000 is the wage compensation provided under the Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana (PMKVY) 3.0 scheme.

 
 
• It aims to provide skill development training to the youth and improve their employability.
 
 
 
• Rs. 8000 is the wage compensation provided under the National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme (NAPS).
 
 
• It aims to promote apprenticeship training and increase the participation of employers and apprentices in the scheme.
